Class ReferenceAdapters

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.core.ReferenceAdapters
@Internal public final class ReferenceAdapters extends Object
The method references a metafactory cannot link to their method directly, which are written as a lambda calling it.
Since:
2.3

    • capturesReceiverValue

      public static boolean capturesReceiverValue(MethodReferenceExpression reference)
      Whether the receiver of a reference is read where the adapter is invoked unless the writer reads it first: a field, which a bound reference reads once, where it is created. The writer reads it, checks it is not null, holds it in a local and passes the local to varargsAdapter(MethodReferenceExpression, ExpressionDef).
      Parameters:
      reference - The reference
      Returns:
      Whether the receiver is read into a local before the adapter is written
